title: SearchBox widget does not change its state after calling helpers.setState
body:
## 🐛 Bug description
`search.helper.setState({query: undefined});` does not clear the SearchBox widget state.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

1. Go to https://jsfiddle.net/7d9zr0ja/3/
2. Click on "Open search popup"
3. Type a text to the input field
4. Click on "Close"
5. Open the popup again - you can see that input has a value.

**Live reproduction:**

https://jsfiddle.net/7d9zr0ja/3/

## 💭 Expected behavior

There is an API method that allow to clear SearchBox widget state programmatically.

## Additional context
Hi there!
I expected that `search.helper.setState` would change state for SearchBox too, but it did not happen. Maybe there is another way to achieve this? I tried to find one, but nothing worked.
Thank you!

comments.body: Seems like the search box indeed doesn't listen to outside values, only local. A first workaround is to manually clear the value and send an input event: https://jsfiddle.net/8zvudgq5/12/

Could you rather use the `refine` function of the `searchBox` from the [`renderState`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/render-state/js/#examples)?

We don't usually recommend using the helper directly.

NOTE: for using renderState you will need to update your InstantSearch installation

@francoischalifour, I will use `refine` instead of using the helper directly, thank you. Unfortunately, it also doesn't reset the local input state. Thus, I am going to use the workaround proposed by @Haroenv.
Thank you for your help!
